judgment.explanation: The English statement asserts that the nonnegative greatest common divisor (gcd) of any two integers a and b is an integer combination of a and b. This is equivalent to stating that an integer x and y exist such that the gcd equals a multiplied by x plus b multiplied by y. This is a stronger statement in Lean because it implies uniqueness (up to sign), while the expected statement does not explicitly assert uniqueness but implies it through the existence quantifier and the definition of gcd as a combination of a and b.
